topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: Rain's been pouring down like the sky's got a leak, and here I am, staring at a notice – "Going Condo." Yeah, like that's new. The world’s always changing, turning old things into something shiny and new, leaving the rest of us behind. They say progress, but it’s hard to see it when you’re walking the same puddles every day. Ain't no use in arguing with walls, they never listen. Least I got a place for tonight, maybe even a few more. But everything ends, you knew that when you started. I guess it’s time to look for another corner, another view of the rain.
